milestones.title: Key access types are reviewed against the ACP-240 edition your organization receives

remediation: OpenBao cannot do ECDH, so the key that opens objects sent to your organization is an RSA-3072 key held in OpenBao, not a P-256 key. It works with partners that use RSA key access. Revisit it when OpenBao adds ECDH or the exchange gains a post-quantum key access type.
title: The exchange receiving key is RSA-3072 because OpenBao has no ECDH
